brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested 16 Palestinian workers Thursday after discovering them inside a truck in an area east of Bethlehem in the occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. Local sources said forces stopped the vehicle during the operation. The detention marked another instance of Israeli military activity targeting Palestinian laborers in the territory.

Video footage documented the arrest, according to the report. The circumstances surrounding why the workers were traveling in the truck and their current status remained unclear from available accounts.
